method.reason: Choose B3LYP as the linear-response TDDFT functional for this neutral singlet acetone system. It is an explicit hybrid functional supported by the official ORCA documentation shown in the retrieved example, and it is practical within the 4-core/192-MB-per-process budget. Full linear-response TDDFT (TDA false) will be used to retain the requested vertical singlet excitations; this choice is a method selection, not an experimental validation.

sources.quote: TDA false Switch off for full TDDFT.

basis.reason: Use the def2-SVP orbital basis for the B3LYP TDDFT calculation. It is explicitly illustrated in the official ORCA TDDFT documentation and keeps the response calculation within the stated budget for a 10-atom molecule. The basis is a computational choice and is not asserted as experimental evidence.
